newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-BEVAN LIKELY TO PLAY IN FOURTH TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BEVAN LIKELY TO PLAY IN FOURTH TEST.

text.p: All-rounder Michael Bevan is likely to play against West Indies in the fourth test starting on Saturday to give Australia the attacking option of another spinner.

Although Australia lead the five-test series 2-1 and need only a draw at the Adelaide Oval to retain the Frank Worrell trophy, captain Mark Taylor said on Friday he did not plan to go on the defensive.

Taylor said history showed almost all recent tests bewteen the two countries had ended with a result and added Australia were likely to name two fast bowlers, two spinners and six specialist batsmen rather than seven.
"If we play Bevo (Bevan) at seven it won't be a conservative option," he said.
"It will be purely because we want to play two spinners in tandem with two quicks. To think about going into a test match and playing for a draw with seven batsmen would be a very dangerous option.
"So far this series we've had three tests and three results."
Australia, who ended West Indies' 15-year unbeaten record in 1995, began the series in commanding style with crushing wins in Brisbane and Sydney.
But a resurgent Curtly Ambrose, transformed from the lethargic figure of the first two tests, exploded into action in the third test in Melbourne, giving West Indies victory within three days.
In addition Brian Lara, seemingly unable to cope with Glenn McGrath's off-cutters in the first three tests, has scored 295 runs in the first three one-day matches of the New Year.
West Indies do have injury worries over their aging pacemen.
Ambrose had a groin strain and had to bat with a runner in his last match while captain Courtney Walsh has a nagging leg injury.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Hayden, Justin Langer, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Glenn McGrath.

West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Robert Samuels, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Phil Simmons, Junior Murray, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Cameron Cuffy, Courtney Walsh (captain).
